human_actions_pending.description: Decide whether to continue into the remaining ~13 Wave 7 plans and Waves 8-16 in this session, given their scale (dozens of files, Playwright visual suites, and a Windows CI mutation gated behind explicit user authority per 13-VALIDATION.md's Wave 15).

decisions.decision: Use strict generated semantic tokens and DS001-DS010 fail-closed checker as the UI authority.
decisions.rationale: Prevents future agents from guessing or silently adding one-off styling.

decisions.decision: Use a proof-only hash-locked local-module replacement plus Go overlay for packaged WebView2 CDP.
decisions.rationale: Wails v2/go-webview2 discards environment CDP arguments; the bridge proves the shipped desktop dialog without changing production dependencies or runtime defaults.

decisions.decision: Do not waive fixture/scene violations with broad exceptions.
decisions.rationale: The user requested enforced consistency; actual primitive/token migration is required.

decisions.decision: Added a new NumberStepper primitive (frontend/src/components/primitives/NumberStepper/) rather than accept a DS005 exception for ProjectFixtures' quantity/universe/address steppers.
decisions.rationale: The exception mechanism can only resolve a match to exactly one diagnostic; two near-identical raw chevron buttons in one file always produce two matches, making a narrow exception structurally impossible. TempoControls.tsx (Plan 13-15-02) has the identical pattern and can adopt this primitive when that plan runs.

decisions.decision: Fixed a real bug in the SceneStack pattern (idle scenes tagged 'armed'/warning tone; Chip text was the raw lowercase tone instead of brand-required 'LIVE') and removed a resulting duplicate LIVE indicator in ScenesLooksWorkspace's scene-detail header.
decisions.rationale: Both were inherited from the interrupted prior session's uncommitted edits; the composition test (243fc2a7) fixes the on-screen LIVE count at exactly 2.

decisions.decision: Fixed scripts/design-system/check.mjs's exception-matching logic (exact diagnostic.value equality preferred, falling back to per-diagnostic -- not file-wide -- substring containment) rather than route around it.
decisions.rationale: The prior substring fallback tested the whole file's source independent of which diagnostic was under test, so it silently matched every diagnostic of the same rule in a file once the match string appeared anywhere -- structurally impossible to except more than one same-rule violation per file regardless of match precision. Confirmed via an isolated single-record empirical test before concluding it wasn't a mistake in Desk's own exception records. User chose this over file-fragmentation. Verified against the checker's own existing 4-case test matrix plus Desk's 29-record desk.json.

decisions.decision: Superseded both fader slider-thumb pseudo-elements' border-radius (2px->--ds-radii-small/4px) and loosened .faderScaleTickNumber's line-height (1->1.1) rather than except them.
decisions.rationale: Both pairs carried byte-identical diagnostic values (::-webkit-slider-thumb/::-moz-range-thumb; .faderValue/.faderScaleTickNumber), which even the fixed matching logic cannot individually except -- two diagnostics with identical rule+path+value are inherently ambiguous by the checker's own design. User-approved real, minimal, visually-modest value changes over file-splitting.

decisions.decision: Added src/design-system/utilities.css (.ds-sr-only) instead of exceptioning FaderLearnHitArea's local sr-only span's margin:-1px.
decisions.rationale: 'margin' is a mechanically DS001-exception-banned word (spacing exceptions are categorically forbidden); no shared sr-only utility existed anywhere else in the codebase to reuse, so centralizing it is a genuine gap-fill, not scope creep.
